The '''Fourth Batallion''' was a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of the [[Sixth Regiment]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TGHHQ" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the operations of the Fourth Batallion were supervised by an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Imperial Liaison|liaison officer]] who squeezed its budget pretty tight.<ref name="SWG:TGHHQ" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the battalion ran wilderness fake-fire training exercises for new recruits. During the exercise, an inexperienced trainee blundered right into some wild carnivorous creature and was disemboweled on the spot. In order to prevent the incident to repeat, the officers of the battalion hired an independent strike team to hunt and eliminate the wild animals living in the training ground.<ref name="SWG:TGHHQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fourth Batallion was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TGHHQ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
